options: A meaning together with one of the three times
A meaning only together with another word
The name of a person or thing
items.explanation: The verb joins an act to a time: past, present or future.

items.prompt: Which word is a verb by its sign here?
options: naṣara, because qad comes before it
items.explanation: Qad is a particle; coming before naṣara, it is a sign that naṣara is a verb.

items.prompt: Which of these is a sign of the verb in al-Ājurrūmiyya?
options: The tāʾ of the feminine with sukūn, as in naṣarat
items.explanation: Tanwīn, al- and khafḍ belong to the noun; the tāʾ with sukūn belongs to the verb.
